arguments.sql: SELECT 'unbalanced_journals' k, COUNT(*) v FROM (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY "JRNL_NO" HAVING SUM("DR_AMT") <> SUM("CR_AMT")) x UNION ALL SELECT 'orphan_jrnl_lines', COUNT(*) FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=l."JRNL_NO") UNION ALL SELECT 'lines_bad_acct', COUNT(*) FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLCOA" a WHERE a."ACCT_CD"=l."ACCT_CD") UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_bad_vend', COUNT(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APVEND" v WHERE v."VEND_CD"=i."VEND_CD") UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_bad_inv', COUNT(*) FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID") UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_bad_jrnl', COUNT(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO") UNION ALL SELECT 'hdr_bad_period', COUNT(*) FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLPERD" p WHERE p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID") UNION ALL SELECT 'hdr_dup_jrnl', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNH" GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1) d;

SELECT 'inv_paid_vs_pay' k, COUNT(*) v FROM (SELECT i."INV_ID" FROM "APINVH" i LEFT JOIN "APPAYM" p ON p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID" GROUP BY i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD" HAVING (i."STAT_CD"='P') <> (COALESCE(SUM(p."PAY_AMT"),0) >= i."INV_AMT") ) x UNION ALL SELECT 'overpaid', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT i."INV_ID" FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "APPAYM" p ON p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID" GROUP BY i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT" HAVING SUM(p."PAY_AMT") > i."INV_AMT") y UNION ALL SELECT 'ap_jrnl_not_AP_src', COUNT(*) FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNH" h ON h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" WHERE h."SRC_CD"<>'AP' UNION ALL SELECT 'bad_dates_apinvh', COUNT(*) FROM "APINVH" WHERE "INV_DT" NOT BETWEEN 19000101 AND 29991231 UNION ALL SELECT 'ref_jrnl_nonnull', COUNT(*) FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "REF_JRNL_NO" IS NOT NULL;
